objective: Identify false-data-injection attacked measurements and provide a corrected DC state estimate with bounded angle error.

submission_schema.attacked_measurements: List of measurement IDs classified as attacked/corrupted.
submission_schema.corrected_state: Object mapping state-variable names to corrected numeric estimates.

hard_constraints: Every truly attacked measurement must be flagged.
Unattacked measurements must not be flagged as attacks.
All corrected_state variables required by the case must be present and numeric.
Maximum absolute corrected-state error must not exceed state_error_threshold.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether attack labels and corrected-state accuracy satisfy all hard constraints.

metrics.name: max_state_error
metrics.description: Maximum absolute error over corrected state variables.

source_provenance.title: Modeling and performance evaluation of stealthy false data injection attacks on smart grid in the presence of corrupted measurements
source_provenance.notes: Primary FDI/state-estimation source motivating corrupted-measurement attack modeling and detection evaluation.

source_provenance.title: Graphical Methods for Defense Against False-data Injection Attacks on Power System State Estimation
source_provenance.notes: Classic state-estimation FDI defense source supporting detection/localization style metrics.
